method.topics: Compare every relative file name and raw SHA256 to the complete pre-HUD topic entries; detect additions, deletion, non-regular replacements and changed bytes. The baseline tree digest is retained as provenance, not recomputed with an assumed serialization.
method.historicalTracked: Enumerate every docs/test-results blob from the exact HEAD tree; stream raw git cat-file blobs into SHA256 and compare to current regular-file bytes. New untracked HUD and preceding uncommitted topics are not inferred from HEAD.
method.backend: Compare all 83 baseline .gd/.mjs.txt source hashes; list newly added scripts separately.
boundaries: This is byte-preservation evidence, not a functional correctness or full application result.
No source, historical topic or tracked evidence was restored or rewritten by this check.
Original failed log and its receipt counts are retained; log bytes were copied without rewriting internal paths.
Timestamps on archived logs preserve their original filesystem mtime; these are provenance timestamps, not a fabricated test start time.
